analysis.detector: actual C PairStream and fixed 61-feature causal path
analysis.classifier: existing weighted per-series logistic heads, C=1, no tuning
analysis.folds: leave one source volunteer out; models train on paired measured data from other volunteers only
analysis.coverage_denominator: all eligible source series before placement-specific rejection; abstentions count as failures in primary score
analysis.primary_gate: no patient-placement accuracy or ranking unless predeclared calibration gate passes on held-out people
analysis.calibration_fit: training volunteers only; no per-test clock, transform, scaling, or threshold fit
analysis.comparisons: each candidate uses the exact same held-out source cohort within side and task
analysis.decision_rule: no candidate selection from outer held-out curves; any observed winner is exploratory

diagnostic_fallback.label: model-response / series-label-agreement diagnostic; not patient accuracy

sensor_constraints.notes: The assumed ±3 g rail is a rig approximation; feasibility reports clipping and feature coverage.
